comment_data.body: Might be worth double-checking that this is still true (if you haven't already done so): https://github.com/pypy/pypy/commit/32449ff30530abd6f1b7979f954183e9a967ddad
Thanks, I hadn't verified it yet. According to their release tags, it's been there since PyPy3.5 (v5.9.0), which we don't support any more. I'll remove both special cases.

commit.message: Deduplicate and share constant frozenset objects.
Optimise "for in set" into frozendict iteration.
Mark constant frozensets as immortal to improve their refcounting behaviour.
Remove arg=NULL special case from __Pyx_PyFrozenSet_New() and handle it via code generation.
Fix copy&paste bug to use the correct code writer for the constant.

milestone.description:
Main features:
- Pattern matching
- Generics / subscripted container types
- `@cython.collection_type()`
- `restrict`
- more vectorcalls
- more thread safety
- smaller modules, more shared code
- remove Py3.8 support, keep Py3.9+
